_meta.description: Curated SYNTHETIC catalogue of low-impact, community-oriented activities. Operator names are invented; the activity types and impact reasoning are generic and illustrative.
_meta.impact_definition: Impact is judged on how the activity is reached (foot/bike/transit vs. car/boat), whether it consumes a scarce local resource, and whether revenue stays in the destination community.
